title: Verify complete fresh-browser recovery
description: Import a complete versioned backup into a clean browser context and verify equivalent normalized scenes, deterministic PDF hashes, project snapshots, sheet instances, printing setups, and calibration drafts supported by the release.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean context with no application records accepts the canonical current-version backup through public import behavior
Recovered projects, snapshots, templates, assignments, assets, sheet instances, setups, revisions, attestations, preparations, drafts, and observations match canonical source state
Normalized printable scenes and deterministic PDF hashes equal the source fixture expectations
Demo versus physical provenance and uncalibrated/evidence-blocked language survive recovery
Recovery works offline after installation and does not depend on source-browser storage

steps.details: Build one intentionally small complete workspace through public operations with representative durable types through PRD 25 and expected canonical identities/hashes.
Download the versioned workspace bundle and record expected manifest, normalized scene, PDF hash, snapshot, instance, setup, and draft results.
Create a fresh isolated browser context, confirm storage is empty, block network after installation, and import through public UI.
Verify canonical records, exact assets, relationships, scenes, hashes, provenance, diagnostics, and evidence-safe language against expectations.
Restart the recovered context offline and repeat representative project, preview, preparation, setup, sheet, and calibration-draft checks.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; keep the canonical fixture deliberately small and reuse deterministic hash helpers.
Equivalent software artifacts do not prove physical printing, alignment, calibration, or safe refeeding.
